channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Santa Anita consensus picks for Saturday, February 14, 2026
item.description: The consensus box of Santa Anita horse racing picks comes from handicappers Bob Mieszerski, Eddie Wilson, Kevin Modesti and Mark Ratzky. Here are the picks for thoroughbred races on Saturday, February 14, 2026.

item.title: Judge dismisses charges against 3 Connecticut officers accused of mistreating paralyzed prisoner
item.description: The officers were accused of mistreating a prisoner after he was paralyzed in a police van.

item.title: A California photographer is on a quest to photograph hundreds of native bees
item.description: Krystle Hickman has photographed over 300 types of bees native to North America.

item.title: Immigration officials plan to spend $38.3 billion to boost detention capacity to 92,000 beds
item.description: ICE plans 16 regional processing centers with a population of 1,000 to 1,500 detainees.

item.title: Lunar New Year: A look at the Year of the Horse
item.description: The Chinese New Year celebration starts with the new moon on the first day of the new year and ends on the full moon 15 days later.

item.title: 9 months after shooting that left her son dead, Moreno Valley mother charged with manslaughter
item.description: Teesha Lucas, 47, told investigators she felt threatened by her son, but surveillance footage showed he wasn't armed, authorities said.

item.title: NBA All-Star Celebrity Game: Rome Flynn repeats as MVP, Team Giannis wins
item.description: The actor/model scores 17 points as Team Giannis beats Team Anthony, 65-58, in a game that brought basketball back to the Forum for the first time in years. Former NBA player Tacko Fall scores 20 points for the losing side.

item.title: 76ers’ VJ Edgecombe leads Team Vince to Rising Stars title, shares Abdul-Jabbar moment
item.description: The 20-year-old guard, who was named Rising Stars MVP after a 17-point semifinal effort and his game-winning free throws in the final, says meeting basketball icon Kareem Abdul-Jabbar is his All-Star Weekend highlight.

item.title: Blair boys basketball battles back from double-digit deficit to beat Bonita
item.description: Simieon Alawode leads the way with a game-high 22 points and six 3-pointers to help Blair reach the CIF-SS Division 4 quarterfinals.

item.title: Bishop Amat freshman Omar Cox-Labomme leads comeback over Chino Hills
item.description: Cox-Labomme scored 23 points to help Bishop Amat beat Chino Hills to advance to Tuesday's CIF-SS Division 4 quarterfinals
